note: Work: the Employment and Labour Relations Act, 2025, which Botswana's Daily News (the Government's news service, 19 August 2026) reports came into force on 1 September 2026, prohibits, in the minister's account of its Part II, employing children under 15, allows employing children of 15 and above with restrictions, and forbids hazardous, underground and night work by children. The Act's own text wasn't reached (Botswana's e-laws site didn't answer), so this rests on the minister's summary as the Government's news service reports it, and whether the Act makes an exception for child performers (the old Employment Act's light-work exception, for one) wasn't read: a performer under 15 is held as barred on the summary's words alone, a reading to check against the Act. Majority and service: not read; no statute setting the age of majority or calling anyone to military service was reached.

sources.title: Daily News (Government of Botswana), Labour relations act to commence September, 19 August 2026
sources.said: Botswana’s Employment and Labour Relations Act of 2025 will come into effect on Sept 1, 2026 ... Part II of the act provided for protection against child labour by amongst others, prohibiting persons from employing children who are under the age of 15 years and with restriction allowed persons to employ children who are 15 years and above.
